newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine bolsa seen extending rally after holiday.
newsitem.headline: Argentine bolsa seen extending rally after holiday.

text.p: Argentine stocks were seen extending Friday's rally when trading resumes Tuesday after a three-day pause for a holiday Monday, dealers said.
"The local market should extend its rally on the back of a good economic international environment, mostly in New York," said Norman Trabucco of brokers Zaracan.
"The Argentine market has been climbing due to favorable local indicators," he said. "And international rates stability and increasing funds inflows towards Latin America add to good expectations."
The blue chip Merval .MERV index rose Friday 1.78 percent to close at 802.95 points, its highest level in almost five years, on very strong volume of $42.3 million.
Another broker of a major foreign bank agreed the local stock market would keep last week's strong upsurge.
"There is a strong investment inflow into Latin America from Europe, mainly from France, after the socialist victory in the polls in that country," he said.
Initially those funds went to the United States in search of low risk investments like Treasury bonds and after good short-term yields they turned to Latin America, he added.
Neverthelles he cautioned the local market may be nearing its highs.
